name: Better Stack
description: Better Stack lets agents check monitors and incidents, query logs and metrics, and read on-call schedules in the signed-in team. Each user signs in to their own Better Stack account through the browser.

prompts.text: Which incidents are open, and what caused them?
Find the most frequent errors in the API logs in the last hour.
Who is on call this weekend?

apps.name: Better Stack
apps.description: Monitor, incident, and log tools, over Better Stack's MCP server with browser sign-in.
